I'm looking for the following b-sides. I'll be more than happy if someone can make those WAV/FLAC collections of all her CDs. But just these songs is also fine:

2. Something's Gonna Happen (b-side to Northern Star)
3. Angel On My Shoulder (b-side to Goin' Down)
4. I Want You Back (b-side to Goin' Down)
5. I Wonder What It Would Be Like (b-side to Never Be The Same Again)

6. Love To You (b-side to Here it Comes Again)
7. Like That (b-side to Here It Comes Again)
8. Living Without You (b-side to Here It Comes Again)
9. I Love You Without Trying (b-side to On The Horizon)
